### Styling

<Canvas of={TooltipStories.Styling} />

Custom styles used in this sample below

```css
.custom-tooltip,
.custom-tooltip-arrow:before {
  background-color: #ffffff !important;
  border: 1px solid #666 !important;
  color: #333 !important;
}
.custom-tooltip-target {
  border: 2px dashed red;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 16px;
}
```

### Delay

You can customize enter and exit delay by choosing one of three values : none, medium and long.

<Canvas of={TooltipStories.Delay} />
